scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The infinite persistence claim is proved symbolically; finite computation is used only to close the exact range \(2\le n\le11\) and as regression evidence.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: The statement concerns ordinary Plücker degrees and compares different Grassmannians at fixed ambient vector-space dimension. Novelty remains subject to the residual risk of an equivalent rectangular-tableau result under different terminology.

title: A sharp log-concavity cutoff for Plücker degrees of Grassmannians
